panels.text: The draft SoW has been created and is currently with Barry for review before submission to SJP. xPression / Transform dependencies discussed on the call with SJP and OpenText this week.  SJP needs to agree on the promotional model for the Documentum stack with OpenText. OpenText have requested details on the network protocols.  AWS Snowball device(s) will be used to handle the file storage transfer.

Currently decommissioning the North Europe DC’s. The further DC migration is blocked by the PROD/NonPROD connectivity. Enterprise in Cloud is the current priority and will continue to receive primary resource allocation. Work on DC Exit will progress as capacity becomes available.
